name: @capiro/meri-contracts
description: Public distribution of frozen Meri wire shapes; validation grants no authorization

scripts.build: node generate.mjs && node generate-actions.mjs && node generate-documents.mjs
scripts.check:generated: node generate.mjs --check && node generate-actions.mjs --check && node generate-documents.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext test/public-types.ts test/action-application-public-types.ts test/document-application-public-types.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run test:public
